skill.name: relight
skill.description: Relight still images with RunComfy. It guides model choice, lighting prompts, and CLI usage for product, portrait, and scene edits.
skill.summary: Relight still images through RunComfy with model routing and lighting prompt guidance.
skill.author: doany-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, model names, documentation links, and placeholder URLs. Confirmed risks are limited to intentional RunComfy CLI execution, package-manager installation guidance, credential-related login behavior, and third-party processing of image URLs and prompts. No evidence of prompt injection, malicious command construction, reconnaissance, or credential exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: RunComfy CLI commands are central to the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Keep the allowed tool scope limited to Bash(runcomfy *) and avoid adding npm, npx, shell, or file-read commands to agent permissions.

remediation.issue: Image URLs and prompts are sent to an external model service.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for user consent before processing sensitive images and document RunComfy data handling expectations in marketplace copy.

remediation.issue: The CLI stores or uses API tokens for authenticated requests.
remediation.suggestion: Never print, inspect, or copy token files; keep file permissions restrictive and prefer scoped environment tokens in CI.

content.value_statement: Relighting images can be slow when users must choose models and write precise lighting prompts. This skill routes still-image relighting through RunComfy models with practical prompt guidance.
actual_capabilities: Routes dedicated relighting requests to Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA.
Shows RunComfy CLI usage for relighting still images.
Recommends fallback edit models for broader image edits.
Guides prompts for light source, temperature, direction, and intensity.
Documents token storage, untrusted image URLs, and outbound endpoint boundaries.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a valid RunComfy account or token.
Supports still-image relighting, not video relighting through this CLI route.
Sends image URLs and prompts to an external RunComfy model service.
Output quality depends on the source image, model choice, and prompt precision.

use_cases.title: Relight Product Catalog Images
use_cases.description: Apply consistent window light, studio light, or warm retail lighting to product photos.

use_cases.title: Shift Portrait Lighting Mood
use_cases.description: Change portrait lighting to golden hour, soft window light, or controlled studio setups.

use_cases.title: Prototype Lighting Directions
use_cases.description: Compare lighting directions and color temperatures before committing to a final edit.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Relight
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single still image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight this image with soft warm light from the left. Preserve the subject, pose, framing, and colors.

prompt_templates.title: Product Studio Light
prompt_templates.scenario: Catalog image with a specific commercial lighting style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Relight the product as a clean studio shot with a large softbox from camera-left and gentle shadow on the right.

prompt_templates.title: Portrait Mood Shift
prompt_templates.scenario: Portrait edit with stronger creative direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use RunComfy to relight the portrait as golden hour. Add warm key light, subtle rim light, and preserve identity.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Model Routing
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs relighting plus a broader edit decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the best RunComfy relighting route for this image. Explain the model choice and preserve subject identity during the edit.

output_examples.input: A product photo needs warm window light from the left and a softer shadow.
output_examples.output: The skill selects the dedicated relight route and returns guidance for a warm key light, soft fill, and preserved product color.

output_examples.input: A portrait should look like golden hour without changing the person.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a portrait-focused prompt that preserves identity, framing, and pose while changing color temperature and light direction.

output_examples.input: A scene needs lighting changes plus a background edit.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a broader edit endpoint instead of the dedicated relight route because the request is not relighting only.

best_practices: State the light source, color temperature, direction, and intensity in the request.
Ask the model to preserve subject identity, framing, pose, and important colors.
Use only image URLs that the user explicitly provided for the relighting task.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for text-to-image generation from scratch.
Do not send private or regulated images without user approval.
Do not broaden the Bash tool scope beyond the RunComfy command pattern.

faq.question: What does this skill relight?
faq.answer: It relights still images by changing lighting direction, color temperature, intensity, and mood.

faq.question: Which model does it prefer?
faq.answer: It prefers Qwen Edit 2509 Relight LoRA for dedicated relighting requests.

faq.question: Can it edit more than lighting?
faq.answer: It can route broader edits to other RunComfy edit models when relighting is part of a larger task.

faq.question: Does it require an account?
faq.answer: Yes. The RunComfy CLI requires login or a RunComfy token before model requests can run.

faq.question: Where are images processed?
faq.answer: The skill sends image URLs and prompts to RunComfy model endpoints for processing.

faq.question: Can it relight video?
faq.answer: No. The documented CLI route is for still images, not video relighting.
